name: Animate: Skeletal Smith spawns within interaction range (#10015)
contract: Animate: Skeletal Smith 804681 summons a gossip-interactive repair vendor (creature 50261,
TARGET_DEST_CASTER_RANDOM with EffectRadiusIndex[0] 14 (8 yd fixed radius), a radius meant for disposable
combat pets and not clamped for this NPC's actual use case, so it could land anywhere up to 8 yd away -
farther than INTERACTION_DISTANCE (5.5 yd) - leaving the repair vendor unreachable by gossip. The fix
re-anchors the summon point to 3 yd from the caster, in the same direction the DBC's random point picked,
before AscensionNecromancerSummons.cpp's shared Summon() adds its own small per-minion offset, so the final
spawn point stays within interaction range.

steps.label: SETUP: the Skeletal Smith is raised
DISCRIMINATING: the Skeletal Smith is not farther than interaction range from its owner
